subject: Invoice timing and temporary credit request
messages:
From: Anna Sokolov <anna.sokolov@medicrestlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: finance@medicrestlabs.com
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary early-pay window & credit increase for Q4

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from MediCrest finance — our year-end collections came in later than expected and we have a compression in our cash conversion for December. We have an upcoming PO (4567) for the Redwood Dedicated pilot (approx $165k). Can Redwood make an exception to accelerate the first invoice (normally Net30) to Net15, or allow a 50% deposit with the balance Net30/60 to help us onboard before year-end?

Separately, we'd like to request a temporary credit ceiling increase to $250k (from $120k) while the pilot is active. We can provide the signed PO and projected usage numbers. We understand this is outside standard terms, so flagging early to get your feedback.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Anna Sokolov
Head of Finance, MediCrest Labs
anna.sokolov@medicrestlabs.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: MediCrest-PO-4567.pdf (application/pdf, 72KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Sokolov <anna.sokolov@medicrestlabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary early-pay window & credit increase for Q4

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO. We can move on this quickly. A few practical items so we can put an actionable plan together: 

- Naomi (billing) — can we provision a 50% advance option on PO 4567 and prepare an interim invoice template?
- Diego (AM) — will work with MediCrest on a short MAP (mutual action plan) that outlines onboarding milestones tied to the deposit/remaining invoices.
- MediCrest — we’ll need VAT registration evidence and a copy of the signed PO (attached) for our finance team to process the credit change.

Preliminarily, Redwood can approve a time-limited credit increase up to $250k if we receive the signed PO + VAT docs and set a 60-day review. Proposed payment schedule we can offer: 50% deposit upon signature, remaining 50% split across Net30 and Net60 invoices (or a single Net30 at your preference).

I’ll pull legal/finance in for an expedited review. If agreed, I can send a short amendment for signature (DocuSign).

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Proposed-Updated-MAP.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request: temporary early-pay window & credit increase for Q4

Jordan / Diego — I reviewed MediCrest’s credit history (Net30/Net45 mix) and their ledger looks healthy, but their typical ceiling is $120k. For a fast path: finance can approve a temporary uplift to $225k with these conditions:

- 50% deposit cleared before provisioning;
- Signed PO + VAT registration (or EU VAT ID if applicable) uploaded to our portal;
- 60-day review with rollback clause if usage/aging deteriorates;
- Early-pay discount optional: 1.0% if invoice paid within 10 days of receipt (applies to non-deposit balance).

Can Karthik weigh in on whether the 1.0% early-pay discount works with the offer we typically give to pilots?

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

--
Note: attaching the draft invoice schedule template and sample amendment for the increase — will populate once Jordan confirms the structure.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request: temporary early-pay window & credit increase for Q4

Naomi / Jordan — 1.0% early-pay is acceptable for pilots; legal prefers to keep the rollback language explicit (60-day review, automatic revert unless a renewal agreement is executed). Also confirm whether VAT evidence is a scanned VAT certificate or a portal upload — Banking/AR needs a reliable audit trail.

I suggest we prepare:
- Amendment (DocuSign) that sets the temporary ceiling to $225k, deposit terms, early-pay discount, and the 60-day review clause;
- MAP outlining milestones (50% deposit -> staging -> production -> final invoice);
- HubSpot deal note to track the ramp & credit-review trigger.

Once Naomi drops the invoice template, I can sign off and route to Legal for a one-business-day turnaround.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Sokolov <anna.sokolov@medicrestlabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary early-pay window & credit increase for Q4

Anna — appreciated the quick turnaround on the PO. Confirming the agreed path: 

1) Temporary credit ceiling: $225,000 for 60 days (effective on receipt of signed amendment).
2) Payment schedule for PO 4567: 50% deposit upon signature (invoice 1, due on receipt), remaining 50% split into one Net30 invoice for the balance. We can also issue the balance as Net30/Net60 if you prefer — please confirm.
3) Early-pay incentive: 1.0% off the non-deposit balance if paid within 10 days.
4) Required documentation: signed PO (we have this), VAT registration/certificate uploaded to our secure portal (or reply with a scanned copy), and the signed amendment (DocuSign link below).

I’ve attached a short Mutual Action Plan (Proposed-Updated-MAP.pdf) showing milestones and the billing checkpoints. I also created a HubSpot deal for tracking (link below). Naomi will issue the deposit invoice as soon as we receive the DocuSign counter-signature and VAT document.

DocuSign: https://docuSign.com/tx/ABC12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/MC-2026-Q4-4472

If that works, Diego and I can schedule an onboarding kickoff for this week.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
